SELECT full_record.id, full_record.created_at, full_record.name, full_record.city
FROM (SELECT company.id, company.created_at
FROM permission_company AS company
WHERE company.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND company.city = 'City-42'
  AND company.readable_access_group_ids && ARRAY['00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid]
ORDER BY company.created_at DESC, company.id DESC
LIMIT 50) AS page
JOIN permission_company AS full_record ON full_record.id = page.id
ORDER BY page.created_at DESC, page.id DESC
